faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Medical & Health Office Jayashankar Bhupalpally District (DM&HO Jayashankar Bhupalpally) in Telangana for various contractual positions under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DM&HO Jayashankar Bhupalpally Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 33 vacancies have been announced for various posts including MLHP, Staff Nurse, Medical Officers, Lab Technicians, ANMs, and other specialized roles across the district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of filled application forms in offline mode is 13-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and submit it in person at the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 44 years as of 01-07-2026, with age relaxations provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from ANM, GNM, and B.Sc Nursing to MBBS, BAMS, MD, MLT, MBA, and specialized degrees depending on the specific NHM post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee is applicable based on categories: Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 300/- for SC/ST candidates, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: The selection process is entirely merit-based, calculated using the combined percentage of marks obtained in all years of the qualifying examination (90%) along with age weightage (10%).

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with self-attested documents must be submitted in person at F-25, O/o DM&HO, IDOC, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely contractual under the National Health Mission (NHM) for a duration of 1 year or until actual program needs cease, subject to performance evaluations.
